entry: At the close, if the 2-bar RSI crosses below 30, buy one contract at the next open with a market order.
exit: When the 2-bar RSI crosses back above 70, sell at the next open. There is no profit target.
stop_loss: Stop at 2 ATR below the fill, where ATR is the average of the last 14 true ranges.
filters: Daily NQ futures bars, 2010 to 2026, long only.
